name: provider-openai
description: OpenAI's models for your agents, with an API key or a ChatGPT subscription (Sign in with ChatGPT). An agent names one as `openai/<modelId>`, for example `openai/gpt-5.5`.

environment.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environment.description: An OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com/api-keys). Read by pi-ai only when model.credentials stores nothing for openai.
